# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 2
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 3-4 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 2

---

[Pages 1-6 of the manuscript are lost. Chapter 2 falls entirely within the missing pages. No text survives.]

---

*Council Note (SOPHIA):* All three translating agents concur: no translation is possible. The missing pages are a physical reality of the sole Coptic manuscript. No Greek fragment covers this portion. The consensus for chapters 1-4 is the acknowledgment of absence.
